title: Four Winters and One Short Bench
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：fellow　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fellow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my brother ① met a fellow that no teacher in the school would have thanked, and he said the meeting was the whole of the winter. The ② fellow, meaning the man himself and not the boy, ran four winters and stayed unthanked in the book; a fellow, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unthanked.

Every ③ fellow in that school had the same short bench beside him, and the ④ fellow at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the team and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fellow, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to thank; my brother said the thanking is the part that fills four winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the fellow was the whole of the class, meaning the companion and not the man. The ⑥ fellow, meaning the companion and not any of that, is the only thing in a class that everybody waits for and nobody thanks; fellow, she said, is either somebody you meet or the only word that means both a man and a companion. She said the companion is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ fellow had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short bench. The ⑧ fellow of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one school and four winters of thanking; fellow, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to thank. He said the thanking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fellow I remember is the one thanked in the register, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ fellow, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being thanked; every fellow, she said, is a companion that has agreed to look like a man. She said the companion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家伙；小伙子（指学校里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 那个人（指那个人本身，与孩子相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a fellow 遇到一位同伴
D. n. 同伴（指留给球队的那一位）
E. n. 同伴（抽象总称，指一所学校的同伴之事）
F. n. 同伴（指名册上写到、被致谢的那一位）
G. n. 伙伴；同伴（指一个班级里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）
H. n. 伙伴（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）

items.q: met a fellow that no teacher in the school would have thanked
The fellow, meaning the man himself and not the boy
the fellow at the far side
the fellow was the whole of the class
the fellow had become a line in a register
The fellow of the whole thing
A fellow, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: meet a fellow 意为“遇到一位同伴”，1972 年哥哥遇到了一位学校里没有一位老师肯致谢的同伴。
fellow 意为“那个人”，指那个人本身而不是孩子，他经过了四个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fellow 意为“家伙、小伙子”，指学校里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一条短短的长凳。
fellow 意为“同伴”，指留给球队的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fellow 意为“伙伴、同伴”，指一个班级里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西，姑姑说这位伙伴就是那个班级的全部。
fellow 意为“伙伴”，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西而不是那一位同伴，是班级里人人都等、却无人致谢的东西。
fellow 意为“同伴”，指名册上写到、被致谢的那一位，到 1976 年这一位成了名册里的一行。
fellow 意为“同伴”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的同伴之事是一所学校和四个冬天的致谢。
fellow 意为“同伴”，我记得的是名册上致谢的那一位，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一位。
fellow 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一位同伴是唯一会因为被好好致谢而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年哥哥遇到了一位学校里没有一位老师肯致谢的同伴，他说遇到才是那个冬天的全部。（meet a fellow）
那位同伴，指的是那个人本身而不是孩子，经过了四个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。（fellow）
那所学校里每一位同伴旁边都有同一条短短的长凳。（fellow）
远处那一端同伴，指的是他们留给球队的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（fellow）
姑姑说这位伙伴就是那个班级的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那一位同伴。（fellow）
1980 年母亲说，一位同伴是唯一会因为被好好致谢而变得更好的东西。（fellow）
answers: In 1972 my brother met a fellow that no teacher in the school would have thanked, and he said the meeting was the whole of the winter.
The fellow, meaning the man himself and not the boy, ran four winters and stayed unthanked in the book.
Every fellow in that school had the same short bench beside him.
The fellow at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the team and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My aunt said the fellow was the whole of the class, meaning the companion and not the man.
A fellow, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being thanked.
